title: Validating Tool Arguments and Retrying
learning_objectives: Give a tool a Pydantic argument schema with constraints
Return validation errors to the model as tool messages
Retry a fixed number of times and stop cleanly
entry_point: class BookingArgs(BaseModel); book_room; call_with_validation(model, tool, messages, max_attempts=3)
hints: Inside the loop: `call = reply.tool_calls[0]`, then `tool.invoke(call["args"])` in a try block.

failure_feedback.advice: Use Field(pattern=r'^R\d{3}$') for room and Field(ge=9, le=17) for hour, and @tool(args_schema=BookingArgs).
Append the reply and an error ToolMessage listing each invalid field.
Stop after max_attempts and return (None, max_attempts).
Work on a copy of messages.
